enso.summary: Super El Niño: ONI +2.5°C for Aug–Oct
enso.state: NOAA's Oceanic Niño Index for August–October rose to +2.46°C, up from +2.16°C for July–September and far above the +1.5°C threshold for a strong event (NOAA CPC). Strong El Niños usually peak in northern winter; FEWS NET expects rainfall impacts in East and southern Africa through the season.
enso.for_you: No direct UK action needed. El Niño shifts global rainfall and can raise food prices and disaster risk in exposed regions.

other-conflicts.summary: Pakistan–Taliban border clashes continue; Moyale fighting sends 50,000 Ethiopians into Kenya
other-conflicts.state: Pakistani forces struck Afghan border posts in South Waziristan after cross-border fire, reported on 2 Nov, and mediation remains stalled (Daily Pakistan). In Ethiopia, fighting in Moyale since 18 Oct has driven more than 50,000 people into Kenya, where registration began around 31 Oct (allAfrica, 4 Nov). Neither has become an interstate war or a capital under attack.
other-conflicts.for_you: Check FCDO travel advice for Pakistan's border areas, Afghanistan and southern Ethiopia.
other-conflicts.rubric_hit: Significant deterioration in conflicts not tracked elsewhere = Watch

sources.title: Daily Pakistan — Pakistan again hits Afghan Taliban border posts

cold-storms.summary: Winter storm warnings in US Rocky Mountains; no deadly cold wave
cold-storms.state: The US National Weather Service issued winter storm warnings for mountain areas of Colorado, Wyoming, Utah and Montana on 1–2 Nov, mainly above 10,000 ft (NWS alerts). No deadly cold wave or storm causing widespread outages had been reported as of 4 Nov, and the Met Office had no warnings in force.
cold-storms.for_you: Follow national weather service warnings when travelling in mountain areas.
cold-storms.rubric_hit: No top-tier cold warnings across a major region = Normal

respiratory.summary: Early H1N1 flu season in the US; England's GP flu positivity rising
respiratory.state: UKHSA's 29 Oct report showed flu GP swab positivity in England rising to 11.0%, with ICU admissions edging up, though overall activity was low and COVID falling (UKHSA). In the US, mid-October flu hospitalisations were the highest for that week since 2010–11, driven by a drifted H1N1 strain. UKHSA's next report is due on 5 Nov.
respiratory.for_you: Eligible people can book flu and COVID vaccines through the NHS. Follow UKHSA advice on staying home when unwell.
respiratory.rubric_hit: Hemisphere flu season unusually early = Watch

sources.title: UKHSA — National flu and COVID-19 surveillance report, 29 Oct

medicine-shortages.summary: US chemotherapy drug shortages persist after Pfizer plant flooding
medicine-shortages.state: Cytarabine and irinotecan injections remain on US shortage lists, partly linked to flooding at a Pfizer plant in India expected to disrupt supply into 2028 (FDA). The FDA's daily list shows dozens of current shortages, mainly sterile injectables. No new national rationing or UK Serious Shortage Protocol had been reported as of 4 Nov.
medicine-shortages.for_you: Patients concerned about supply should speak to their pharmacist or prescriber; do not stockpile.
medicine-shortages.rubric_hit: Essential medicine shortage in a major system = Watch; no widespread rationing

sources.title: FDA — Drug shortages database

exploited-vulns.summary: Four new CISA known-exploited vulnerabilities in a week
exploited-vulns.state: CISA added four vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue in the seven days to 4 Nov and 34 in 30 days, under the 11-a-week Watch line. Recent additions include an Apple flaw (4 Nov), WordPress Core (3 Nov) and two Ivanti Connect Secure flaws (30 Oct).
exploited-vulns.for_you: Keep devices and software updated. Organisations using Ivanti Connect Secure or WordPress should apply vendor patches per CISA and NCSC guidance.

sources.title: CISA — Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue

aid-funding.summary: Humanitarian appeals badly underfunded; WFP cut Gaza food aid for 500,000
aid-funding.state: WHO's Sudan health appeal was only 23% funded as of mid-October (WHO, 12 Oct), and WFP cut monthly food aid in Gaza from 1.6 million to 1.1 million people from late October after receiving less than half its usual funding. UNHCR's winter appeal warns resources are dwindling. No new pipeline break was reported as of 4 Nov.
aid-funding.for_you: Aid agencies' appeals are the main route for public support.
aid-funding.rubric_hit: Major ration cuts announced = Watch; no famine-country pipeline break

sources.title: WHO — IPC Sudan alert and appeal funding

uk-supply-margins.summary: NESO expects adequate electricity margins this winter; no notices issued
uk-supply-margins.state: NESO's winter outlook expects GB electricity margins to be the strongest in six years, though some analysts say its assumptions are optimistic (NESO; Watt-Logic, 27 Oct). National Gas reported supply capability well above 1-in-20 peak demand. No margin notices had been issued as of 4 Nov.
uk-supply-margins.for_you: No action needed. NESO and National Gas publish notices if margins tighten.

headline: Hormuz stays largely shut as Iran rejects the US reply to its reopening plan and the IRGC claims tanker mine strikes; Russia hit Ukraine's grid in nine regions on 3–4 Nov. The Bank of England decides on rates on 5 Nov.

situations.name: US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock
situations.summary: Iran called the US reply to its Hormuz plan unconvincing on 3 Nov; IRGC claimed four tankers hit mines on 4 Nov. Brent near $94 on 5 Nov.

situations.name: Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank
situations.summary: Russia fired about 300 drones and 76 missiles at Ukraine's grid on 3–4 Nov, hitting nine regions; talks set for 10–11 Nov in Abu Dhabi.

situations.name: Super El Niño
situations.summary: ONI rose to +2.5 for Aug–Oct: drought risk in East and southern Africa, record-range warmth and faster CO₂ growth.

situations.name: Ebola outbreak, DR Congo
situations.summary: ECDC counted 10,274 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,992 deaths in DR Congo to 28 Oct; imported cases in Kenya and Nigeria; a WHO PHEIC since May.

situations.name: Sudan war
situations.summary: Drone strikes have cut parts of Sudan off the power grid; a strike on a South Kordofan fuel station killed 10 on 4 Nov.

situations.name: France: debt stress and protests
situations.summary: OAT–Bund spread near 160bp on 2 Nov; budget vote delayed and unions hold a general strike on 5 Nov.

situations.name: Energy shock feeding inflation
situations.summary: US CPI 4.0%; Australia hiked to 4.85% on 3 Nov and a Bank of England rise to 4% is expected on 5 Nov.

situations.name: Binance theft and North Korean escalation
situations.summary: FBI blames North Korea for a $6.3bn Binance theft; Pyongyang denied it and fired several missiles on 4 Nov. Binance withdrawals have resumed.
